panels.description: Totals for the selected time range. Owner and Owner email come from the server's Device owner list, matched by serial; they are empty for a Device that isn't on the list. Sessions used counts sessions with at least one model request; a session switched to another account with /login counts for both accounts. Last seen is how long ago the Device last reported while Claude Code was running: green within an hour, yellow within a day, red after that. Claude Desktop app usage has no serial number or hostname, so it is shown as "Desktop app (<user name>)".
